android.desc: Do you want to seem more cultured than you really are? Well then this app is perfect for you. Randomly display a book from long dead people like Austen, Dickens, Twain, Wilde, Shakespeare, Poe, Dostoyevsky, Joyce, Dumas, Kafka, Plato, Kant, Nietzsche and more. You will soon be able to recognize and quote great books if you buy and read this app anytime even when you are without internet access. An app with over nine thousand books should cost over nine thousand dollars. However, this app will only cost you 99 cents. In fact, you are only paying for a select number of these texts. The rest of the texts, such as many by Shakespeare, are given to you free of charge. It is like buy one get one free, except better, since you are only paying for like maybe one book and getting the rest free.
